text:
ana: behold Sir Slimes-a-Lot, my garden snail in a micro-top-hat. he approves of spreadsheets and slow sprints. photo: https://imgur.com/a/snail-hat :snail: :top_hat:
ciro: this is peak monday content. tiny hat, big energy. also pls advise on how to prevent keyboard slime trails :sweat_smile:
mei: scientific question: does he rank PRs by shiny factor or by lettuce leftovers? :thinking_face: :leafy_green:
nana: (typo, meant ana) he ranks by shiny factor but responds to snacks. proven method: post-it notes with cucumber on them. :cucumber::memo:
diego: is there a tiny throne i can 3D print? i want to elevate Sir Slimes-a-Lot during standups. :desktop_computer: :crown:
ops-bot: Reminder: non-service animals must stay in carriage when in shared workspaces. Exceptions require a Facilities note. See https://intranet/company/pets-policy :information_source:
ciro: Filing exception: Sir Slimes-a-Lot increases cross-team morale by 0.0001% per minute of presence. that's measurable. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
mei: also can we get a tiny nameplate that says "All hail slow governance"? very stable leader vibes. :name_badge:
nana: He leaves polite slime compliments on documents. proof attached: "Good job on the Q3 rollout" (in snail trail). :sparkles:
diego: Vote: make Sir Slimes-a-Lot honorary mascot for Tuesday slow-release days. react with :snail: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. current tally: ana :snail:, ciro :snail:, mei :snail:, diego :snail:. unanimous so far.
ops-bot: Facilities note acknowledged. Please keep desk plants covered and wipes handy for trails.
